name: 🎄Merge and Fight
desc:
✨ Welcome to Merge and Fight, An exciting adventure of merging and battling!

How to Play:
🌱Buy seeds and plant them in your garden!
🎍Merge plants to create more powerful ones and fight against the Brainrot!
🧠Defeat Brainrot to help you earn cashes!
⚙️Upgrade your conveyor belt to unlock new plant seeds!

Key Features:
🌻Merge to evolve and grow stronger!
⌚ Remember, your Brainrot keeps earning cash even when you're offline!
